page: Google Cloud Platform a3-edgegpu-8g-nolssd is an accelerator-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor with an x86_64 architecture. It features 208 dedicated vCPUs (104 physical cores with hyper-threading) running at 2.7 GHz, supported by 1872.0 GB of RAM, which equates to 9.0 GB per core. The system integrates eight NVIDIA H100 Hopper GPUs providing a total of 640 GB of VRAM. Notably, this configuration does not include local SSD storage.

In benchmark testing, the server demonstrates top-tier multi-core CPU and memory performance. The multi-core stress-ng CPU performance, passmark CPU score, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression all rank in the top 10%. Memory bandwidth is also highly efficient, with both small-block cached and large-block uncached read operations placing in the top 10%. For specialized workloads, the system achieves top-tier results in Redis SET operations, static web serving throughput, and LLM inference prompt processing for both 135M and 7B parameter models. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Passmark memory scores falling into the average middle 50% range.

From a resource density perspective, this server represents a high-end hardware profile tailored for massive parallelization. The qualitative tradeoff centers on the absence of local SSD storage, meaning data persistence and high-speed local caching must rely on external network storage solutions. Given the presence of eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs and 640 GB of VRAM, this server is optimized for large-scale machine learning, LLM training and inference, ray tracing, and complex scientific simulations.
